title: Slice 641293: [Expense Agent] Expense Locations and Per-diem rules in configurationAdded more locations
summary: Expense Agent now includes comprehensive expense locations for all country/regions with corresponding expense rule headers and conditions to support more detailed per-diem and rule configuration.
key_points: Added expense locations covering all country/regions through new codeunit 7124 Create Expense Locations
Created new codeunits for setting up expense rule conditions (7126) and rule headers (7128) as separate setup operations
Refactored expense category creation logic for better organization
Expanded Expense Agent Setup page with additional configuration options
Updated demo data and setup logic to use the new location-based configuration structure
quote: Adds more locations (basically all country/regions) and corresponding expense rule headers and expense rule conditions.
